items.title: 4.2 Choosing the Right Data Structure for the Problem (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of choosing a data structure (PDF 116-117).

blocks.text: Durust data structure chunne se hal zyada kaarkard aur banane mein aasan hote hain. Agle topics batate hain ke paanch structures, stack, queue, list, tree aur graph, mein se har ek kab sab se munasib hai.

blocks.prompt: Kis soorat ke liye graph sab se munasib hai (MCQ 10)?
blocks.explanation: (c) social network ke rabte dikhana. Kaamon ki list ke liye list aur gahakon ki qataar ke liye queue munasib hai.

items: Structure ko masle se milaiye: stack, queue, list, tree ya graph.
